title: Why Software Engineering Is Indispensable in the Age of Coding Agents
title_zh: 为什么软件工程在编码代理时代不可或缺

paragraphs.en: Can AI make Software Engineering (SE) — the discipline — obsolete? And can it make software engineers — the professionals — redundant? This paper argues that the rise of capable AI coding agents makes SE and software engineers essential, not obsolete: the missing foundation without which AI-assisted development produces misleadingly plausible, unverifiable, and ultimately untrustworthy software. Three structural properties of large language models (probabilistic generation, agnosticism, and semantic statelessness) create a structural vacuum that no amount of training can eliminate. Filling it requires four knowledge levers: methodological knowledge, domain knowledge, design choices, and process choices. All four must be reified as persistent artifacts, and each requires the software engineer as methodologist, mediator, and custodian.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能能否让软件工程（SE）——这一学科——变得过时？ 它又能否让软件工程师——这些专业人士——变得多余？ 本文认为，能力强大的 AI 编码智能体的兴起，反而使软件工程与软件工程师变得不可或缺，而非过时：因为缺少这一基础，AI 辅助开发将产生看似合理却经不起验证、最终不可信赖的软件。 大型语言模型的三项结构性特性（概率性生成、无偏性以及语义无状态性）共同造成了一种结构性真空，这种真空是任何程度的训练都无法消除的。 要填补这一真空，需要运用四种知识杠杆：方法论知识、领域知识、设计决策和流程决策。 这四种知识都必须被具象化为持久的产物，而每一种都需要软件工程师作为方法论专家、协调者和守护者。

paragraphs.en: The advent of coding agents has raised legitimate questions about the fate of Software Engineering and software engineers. To answer them, one may assess empirical data or practitioners’ judgment. The first evidence to enable careful judgment is now emerging: field observation and professional practice, randomized trials, cross-country firm surveys.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体的出现引发了关于软件工程及其工程师未来命运的合理质疑。 要回答这些问题，可以依据经验数据或从业者的判断进行评估。 目前已有初步证据支持审慎的判断：实地观察与专业实践、随机试验以及跨国企业调查。

paragraphs.en: Meyer ( 5 ) , writing in these pages, frames the current moment. He distinguishes three software categories ( acute , business , casual ) and argues that vibe coding — code produced by “giving in to the vibes” rather than engineering — works for the third but not for the first two, where correctness is paramount and coding is only 10–20% of project cost. He names the hallucination loop : a plausible suggestion that sends the developer down a path that will not close. His conclusion: for professional software, AI-assisted development must be paired with formal specification and verification, the move from probable to provable .
paragraphs.zh: Meyer（5）在本刊撰文，对当前时刻进行了阐述。 他将软件分为三类（急性、商业、休闲），并认为“氛围编码”——即通过“顺应氛围”而非工程化方式产生的代码——适用于第三类，但不适用于前两类；在前两类中，正确性至关重要，而编码仅占项目成本的10%至20%。 他将这种幻觉循环命名为：一个看似合理的建议，却会将开发者引向一条无法完成的路径。 他的结论是：对于专业软件而言，人工智能辅助开发必须与形式化规范和验证相结合，从而实现从“可能正确”到“可被证明正确”的跨越。

paragraphs.en: The empirical picture is not uniform. Cui et al. ( 1 ) found in field experiments a 26% increase in completed tasks across 4,867 developers at Microsoft, Accenture, and a Fortune 100 firm, with the largest gains among less experienced developers. Becker et al. ( 2 ) ran a randomized controlled trial with sixteen experienced open-source developers on 246 real tasks in their own mature repositories: those given AI tools took 19% longer than those without, and afterward believed AI had helped. Xu et al. ( 10 ) confirmed this pattern at scale in a study of 2,755 open-source repositories using difference-in-differences: aggregate line-of-code output rose 17.7% after Copilot introduction, but core contributors — those with the deepest ownership of the codebase — saw a 19% decline in original code output, offset by more time spent on code review and pull-request rework. The discriminator is task complexity, codebase maturity, and developer seniority. Time saved on delimited tasks is recaptured on complex ones, spent supervising output that looks plausible but requires an external reference for correctness. That reference lives with the developer, not with the tool.
paragraphs.zh: 实际观察到的情况并不一致。Cui 等人 (1) 在实地实验中发现，微软、埃森哲和一家财富 100 强公司的 4,867 名开发人员完成的任务数量增加了 26%，其中经验较少的开发人员获益最大。Becker 等人 (2) 对十六名经验丰富的开源开发人员进行了随机对照试验，让他们在各自成熟的代码库中处理 246 个真实任务：使用 AI 工具的开发人员完成任务所需时间比不使用工具者多 19%，但事后他们仍认为 AI 提供了帮助。Xu 等人 (10) 在一项涉及 2,755 个开源代码库的研究中，通过“差异中的差异”方法证实了这一模式具有广泛性：Copilot 引入后，代码行总产出增加了 17.7%，但核心贡献者——即对代码库拥有最深层次掌控权的开发者——原创代码的产出下降了 19%，这一影响被他们在代码审查和拉取请求修改上投入更多时间所抵消。 区分因素在于任务的复杂性、代码库的成熟度以及开发人员的资历。 在限定范围内节省的时间会在复杂任务中重新体现出来，这些时间被用于监督那些看似合理但需要外部参考才能确认正确性的输出结果。 这种参考依据存在于开发者自身，而非工具之中。

paragraphs.en: Huang et al. ( 3 ) studied thirteen developers in the field and surveyed ninety-nine more. A distinctive divide has emerged: some developers practice vibe coding, treating interaction flow as evidence of correctness. Professionals do not: they plan, validate output, and retain architectural control, treating the agent as an executor. Where AI-assisted development succeeds, something structured is compensating for what the agent alone cannot do.
paragraphs.zh: Huang 等人 (3) 研究了该领域的十三名开发者，并对另外九十九名开发者进行了调查。 一种明显的分歧已经出现：一些开发者采用“氛围编码”方式，将交互流程视为正确性的证据。 专业人士则不然：他们会进行规划、验证输出结果并保留架构控制，将智能体视为执行者。 在人工智能辅助开发取得成功之处，总有某种结构化机制在弥补智能体单独无法完成的部分。

paragraphs.en: At scale, the Stack Overflow 2025 Developer Survey — nearly forty-nine thousand developers across 177 countries — captures the same ambivalence: 84% adopt AI tools, yet 46% distrust the accuracy of AI output (up from 31%), and 66% cite AI solutions that are “almost right, but not quite” as the top frustration.
paragraphs.zh: 在大规模调查中，Stack Overflow 2025 开发者调查——覆盖了来自 177 个国家的近四万九千名开发者——同样揭示了这种矛盾心态：84% 的开发者采用了人工智能工具，但仍有 46% 的人不信任人工智能输出的准确性（这一比例从 31% 上升），并且有 66% 的人指出，“几乎正确但又不完全准确”的人工智能解决方案是他们最大的困扰。

paragraphs.en: AI coding agents have a structural vacuum: on their own, they lack what they need to succeed. The vacuum follows from what AI tools structurally are; the nature of software makes it consequential, and the state of SE decides whether it is filled. Software is intangible and, as Balzer ( 4 ) observed, “rarely consistent”: requirements evolve, knowledge arrives incrementally, practices carry inconsistencies that are features, not errors. Classical engineering converges on a finished artifact; software never settles, its substrate constantly renegotiated. SE is still young — the NATO Conference dating from 1968 — and applied unevenly. In sixty years that discipline has moved toward the classical engineering disciplines: formal methods, safety standards (DO-178C, IEC 62304, ISO 26262), Empirical Software Engineering, Model-Based Systems Engineering, product line engineering. Yet without it, mature or not, AI tools cannot resolve the problems the evidence lays bare. The two reinforce each other: SE supplies what AI lacks, and AI accelerates SE’s systematic application and improvement.
paragraphs.zh: AI 编码智能体存在一个结构性真空：单凭自身，它们缺乏成功所需的一切。 这种真空源于 AI 工具的结构特性；软件的本质使其影响深远，而软件工程（SE）的状态则决定了这一真空是否被填补。 软件是无形的，正如 Balzer（4）所观察到的那样，“很少保持一致”：需求不断演变，知识逐步积累，实践中的不一致性往往是特性而非错误。 传统工程最终会形成确定的产物；而软件却从未稳定下来，其底层基础始终在持续调整。 软件工程（SE）仍处于起步阶段——最早可追溯至 1968 年的北约会议——且应用尚不均衡。 六十年来，这一学科逐渐向传统工程领域靠拢：形式化方法、安全标准（DO-178C、IEC 62304、ISO 26262）、经验软件工程、模型驱动系统工程以及产品线工程。 然而，即便没有这些方法，无论是否成熟，AI 工具都无法解决证据所揭示的问题。 二者相互促进：软件工程（SE）弥补了 AI 的不足，而 AI 则加速了工程学的系统性应用与改进。

paragraphs.en: The evidence and the practitioner voice reviewed in Section 1 reveal the vacuum; they do not explain it. To do so, we adopt a logical and epistemological approach: examining what AI coding agents structurally are and, from that structure, deriving the roles human knowledge and judgment must necessarily play. The vacuum is not a performance gap: it is a structural condition.
paragraphs.zh: 第 1 节中审查的证据和实践者观点揭示了这一真空状态，但并未对其作出解释。 为此，我们采用一种逻辑和认识论上的方法：考察 AI 编码智能体在结构上的本质，并基于这种结构推导出人类知识与判断必然扮演的角色。 这种真空状态并非性能差距，而是一种结构性条件。

paragraphs.en: Three properties of a large language model define how it operates and, together, constrain what it can and cannot do without external support.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型的三个特性决定了其运作方式，并且这些特性共同限制了在外部支持之下它能够和不能够执行的任务。

paragraphs.en: Probabilistic generation. An LLM does not compute: it generates. Its output is a navigation over a probability distribution conditioned on training and context. And no digital artifact, generated or otherwise, can be validated against the world it represents without a reference external to the model.
paragraphs.zh: 概率生成。 LLM 并非进行计算，而是进行生成。 其输出是在训练数据和上下文条件约束下，对概率分布的一种导航。 任何数字产物，无论是生成的还是其他形式的，都无法在没有模型外部参考的情况下，对其所代表的现实世界进行验证。

sents.en: Probabilistic generation.
sents.zh: 概率生成。

sents.en: An LLM does not compute: it generates.
sents.zh: LLM 并非进行计算，而是进行生成。

sents.en: Its output is a navigation over a probability distribution conditioned on training and context.
sents.zh: 其输出是在训练数据和上下文条件约束下，对概率分布的一种导航。

paragraphs.en: Agnosticism. An LLM has absorbed patterns from vast corpora of code and text; three domains resist that absorption. Each has a reducible surface layer and a structurally irreducible core.

sents.zh: 大型语言模型已经吸收了海量代码和文本语料中的模式；但有三个领域无法被如此吸收。

sents.en: Each has a reducible surface layer and a structurally irreducible core.
sents.zh: 每个领域都包含一个可简化的表层和一个结构上不可简化的核心。

paragraphs.en: Methodological agnosticism. The reducible surface is SE principles — specification methods, architectural styles, testing frameworks — which specialized models can absorb. The irreducible core is evaluative judgment: determining whether this specification for this system meets the bar requires a domain-grounded reference the model cannot generate. Asking the model to evaluate its own output does not help: it lacks that reference, which is difficult, if not impossible, to reify precisely each time.
paragraphs.zh: 方法论上的中立性。 可还原的部分是 SE 原则——即规范方法、架构风格和测试框架——这些是专业模型可以吸收的内容。 不可还原的核心是评估性判断：要确定该系统的具体规范是否达到标准，需要依赖基于实际领域的参考依据，而模型无法生成这种依据。 让模型评估自己的输出并无帮助：它缺乏这种参考依据，而这种依据要么难以每次精确具象化，要么根本不可能做到。

sents.en: Methodological agnosticism.
sents.zh: 方法论上的中立性。

sents.en: The reducible surface is SE principles — specification methods, architectural styles, testing frameworks — which specialized models can absorb.
sents.zh: 可还原的部分是 SE 原则——即规范方法、架构风格和测试框架——这些是专业模型可以吸收的内容。

paragraphs.en: Domain agnosticism. The reducible surface is general domain knowledge (e.g., clinical constraints, regulatory requirements) accessible through RAG, fine-tuning, or domain training. The irreducible core is organization-specific knowledge: continuously renegotiated, semantically defined by the practice it describes, and permanently inconsistent in Balzer’s sense. It can only be managed, never eliminated, and requires ongoing human mediation.
paragraphs.zh: 领域无关性。 可归约的表面层是通用领域知识（例如临床约束、监管要求），这些知识可通过 RAG、微调或领域训练获取。 不可归约的核心是组织特有的知识：它持续被重新协商，通过其所描述的实践在语义上被定义，并且在 Balzer 的意义上具有永久不一致性。 这种核心只能被管理，而无法被消除，并且需要持续的人类介入。

sents.en: Domain agnosticism.
sents.zh: 领域无关性。

sents.en: The reducible surface is general domain knowledge (e.g., clinical constraints, regulatory requirements) accessible through RAG, fine-tuning, or domain training.
sents.zh: 可归约的表面层是通用领域知识（例如临床约束、监管要求），这些知识可通过 RAG、微调或领域训练获取。

paragraphs.en: Evolutionary agnosticism. The reducible surface is general evolution patterns — what design choices constrain future change, what qualities matter in a given domain — in principle trainable. The irreducible core is the project-specific trajectory: what this system must become, given this organization’s constraints, does not exist until the software engineer reasons it into existence. This is a structural absence, not a deficiency of attention.
paragraphs.zh: 进化论不可知论。 可归约的表面是普遍的进化模式——即哪些设计选择会限制未来的变化，以及在特定领域中哪些特性至关重要——原则上这些是可以训练的。 不可归约的核心则是项目特定的发展轨迹：在给定该组织的限制条件下，这个系统必须成为什么；在软件工程师通过推理使其存在之前，这一轨迹并不存在。 这是一种结构性的缺失，而非注意力的不足。

sents.en: Evolutionary agnosticism.
sents.zh: 进化论不可知论。

sents.en: The reducible surface is general evolution patterns — what design choices constrain future change, what qualities matter in a given domain — in principle trainable.

sents.zh: 这是一种结构性的缺失，而非注意力的不足。

paragraphs.en: Semantic statelessness. Within a session, the model retains a working footprint: the context window gives it access to what was said, decided, and produced. Modern systems now add persistent memory across sessions, but as storage or log of prior exchanges — not as a semantic model of accumulated know-how. The architectural decision made last Tuesday, the domain constraint introduced by the expert last week, the specification agreed upon last month: none becomes usable knowledge unless it has been reified as an artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 语义无状态性。 在一次会话中，模型会保留一个工作印记：上下文窗口使其能够访问此前所说的、决定的和生成的内容。 现代系统现在会在跨会话时增加持久化记忆，但这只是作为先前交互的存储或日志，而非积累知识的语义模型。 上周二做出的架构决策、专家上周引入的领域约束、上个月达成一致的规范：除非它们被具体化为某种产物，否则都无法成为可用的知识。

sents.zh: 语义无状态性。

paragraphs.en: The vacuum has a precise structure. Filling it requires four distinct levers.
paragraphs.zh: 这个真空装置具有精确的结构。 要填满它，需要四个不同的杠杆。

sents.en: The vacuum has a precise structure.
sents.zh: 这个真空装置具有精确的结构。

sents.en: Filling it requires four distinct levers.
sents.zh: 要填满它，需要四个不同的杠杆。

paragraphs.en: Methodological knowledge — how to build quality software — is codified by SE as a discipline: fifty years of accumulated practice on specifications, architecture, testing, and process governance.
paragraphs.zh: 方法论知识——即如何构建高质量软件——已被软件工程（SE）作为一门学科加以体系化：五十年来，人们在规范、架构、测试和流程治理方面积累了丰富的实践经验。

paragraphs.en: Domain knowledge — what the system must mean and do in its world — is carried by domain experts: clinicians, operators, traders, and subject-matter specialists who understand the problem the software is built to solve.
paragraphs.zh: 领域知识——即系统在其所处世界中必须表达的含义和应执行的功能——由领域专家承载：这些专家包括临床医生、操作员、交易员以及理解该软件旨在解决的问题的领域专家。

paragraphs.en: Design choices — the project-specific decisions that translate into the product: architectural structures, component boundaries, trade-offs, interfaces. These are produced and owned by the software engineer, informed by both methodological and domain knowledge, and accumulate as the system grows.
paragraphs.zh: 设计决策——项目中具体转化为产品的决定：架构结构、组件边界、权衡取舍和接口。 这些决策由软件工程师生成并负责，其制定既基于方法论知识也基于领域知识，并且随着系统的扩展而不断积累。

sents.en: Design choices — the project-specific decisions that translate into the product: architectural structures, component boundaries, trade-offs, interfaces.
sents.zh: 设计决策——项目中具体转化为产品的决定：架构结构、组件边界、权衡取舍和接口。

sents.en: These are produced and owned by the software engineer, informed by both methodological and domain knowledge, and accumulate as the system grows.
sents.zh: 这些决策由软件工程师生成并负责，其制定既基于方法论知识也基于领域知识，并且随着系统的扩展而不断积累。

paragraphs.en: Process choices — how the work is organized for this specific project: the lifecycle adopted, the criteria for agent autonomy, the review structure.
paragraphs.zh: 流程选择——即针对此特定项目的工作组织方式：所采用的生命周期、智能体自主性的标准以及审查结构。

paragraphs.en: All four levers require reification : they must be materialized as persistent, accessible artifacts. Knowledge that exists only in someone’s head does not exist for a stateless agent.
paragraphs.zh: 所有四个杠杆都需要实体化：它们必须被具现为持久且可访问的实体。 仅存在于某人脑海中的知识，对于无状态智能体而言并不存在。

sents.en: All four levers require reification : they must be materialized as persistent, accessible artifacts.
sents.zh: 所有四个杠杆都需要实体化：它们必须被具现为持久且可访问的实体。

sents.en: Knowledge that exists only in someone’s head does not exist for a stateless agent.
sents.zh: 仅存在于某人脑海中的知识，对于无状态智能体而言并不存在。

paragraphs.en: Three actors do this work. Domain experts supply semantic knowledge — without them, SE structure is form without meaning. The AI agent is the executor, powerful but without intrinsic reference for correctness or future orientation. The software engineer is the active mediator between the two, and the custodian who keeps the system’s evolutionary trajectory explicit over time.
paragraphs.zh: 三名智能体负责这项任务。 领域专家提供语义知识——没有他们，SE 结构就只是没有意义的形式。 AI 智能体是执行者，虽然功能强大，但缺乏内在的参照标准来确保正确性或指导未来方向。 软件工程师是两者之间的主动协调者，也是负责确保系统演化轨迹随时间推移始终保持清晰的守护者。

sents.en: Three actors do this work.
sents.zh: 三名智能体负责这项任务。

sents.en: Domain experts supply semantic knowledge — without them, SE structure is form without meaning.
sents.zh: 领域专家提供语义知识——没有他们，SE 结构就只是没有意义的形式。

sents.en: The AI agent is the executor, powerful but without intrinsic reference for correctness or future orientation.
sents.zh: AI 智能体是执行者，虽然功能强大，但缺乏内在的参照标准来确保正确性或指导未来方向。

sents.en: The software engineer is the active mediator between the two, and the custodian who keeps the system’s evolutionary trajectory explicit over time.
sents.zh: 软件工程师是两者之间的主动协调者，也是负责确保系统演化轨迹随时间推移始终保持清晰的守护者。

paragraphs.en: One might object that these limits are temporary and that enough training data would let the agent learn without human intervention. But the three irreducible cores named in Section 2 are not gaps in training: evaluative judgment, organizational knowledge, and a system’s future trajectory cannot be distilled from any corpus. The vacuum is structural, not historical.
paragraphs.zh: 有人可能会反驳说，这些限制只是暂时的，只要有足够的训练数据，智能体就能在没有人类干预的情况下学习。 但第 2 节中提到的三个不可简化核心并非训练中的空白：评估性判断、组织知识以及系统的未来轨迹，都无法从任何语料库中提取出来。 这种真空状态是结构性的，而非历史性的。

sents.en: One might object that these limits are temporary and that enough training data would let the agent learn without human intervention.
sents.zh: 有人可能会反驳说，这些限制只是暂时的，只要有足够的训练数据，智能体就能在没有人类干预的情况下学习。

sents.en: But the three irreducible cores named in Section 2 are not gaps in training: evaluative judgment, organizational knowledge, and a system’s future trajectory cannot be distilled from any corpus.
sents.zh: 但第 2 节中提到的三个不可简化核心并非训练中的空白：评估性判断、组织知识以及系统的未来轨迹，都无法从任何语料库中提取出来。

sents.en: The vacuum is structural, not historical.
sents.zh: 这种真空状态是结构性的，而非历史性的。

paragraphs.en: The four levers and three actors just described operate through two distinct mechanisms — the soul SE lends to AI to fill the vacuum. The first is constitutive : SE methodology embedded directly in the agent’s design, so that it asks for specifications when they are missing, signals underspecified requirements, and structures its outputs according to SE principles before any human provides project-specific input. The second is operational : the software engineer provides SE-structured artifacts — specifications, architectural contexts, testing frameworks, domain constraints — that give the agent a reference for correctness on each project. The two mechanisms map onto the two layers: constitutive addresses the reducible, operational addresses the irreducible core.
paragraphs.zh: 刚才描述的四个杠杆和三个智能体通过两种不同的机制运作——SE 将自身借予 AI，以填补其中的空白。 第一种是构成性机制：SE 方法论直接嵌入智能体的设计中，因此当缺少规范时，它会主动要求提供规范；当需求描述不完整时，它会发出信号；并且在任何人类提供项目特定输入之前，它会根据 SE 原则组织其输出。 第二种是运行性机制：软件工程师提供经过 SE 结构化处理的成果——包括规范、架构上下文、测试框架和领域约束——这些成果为智能体在每个项目中提供了正确性的参考标准。 这两种机制分别对应两个层次：构成性机制处理可归约的部分，运行性机制则处理不可归约的核心部分。

sents.en: The second is operational : the software engineer provides SE-structured artifacts — specifications, architectural contexts, testing frameworks, domain constraints — that give the agent a reference for correctness on each project.

paragraphs.en: AI, in turn, helps SE close a knowing-doing gap it has long been unable to close on its own: formal requirements, architectural documentation, and systematic testing are demonstrably effective yet consistently underused. CASE tools in the 1980s and 1990s tried to close this gap, resented for their overhead. AI shifts the cost dynamic: reification, verification, and accountability (concepts SE has developed for decades) become cheaper to apply. Specifications, once expensive to produce and maintain outside critical domains, become byproducts of elicitation sessions and can be progressively formalized to reconnect with established SE practices. Tests, once written after the code to verify it, become the reference the agent generates against. Shaw and colleagues call the resulting skill design rather than coding ( 7 ) . Architecture Decision Records, once documentation debt, become the substrate the agent operates on. Practices once confined to critical domains can become ordinary, as the mechanical cost of applying the method drops below the threshold of abandonment.
paragraphs.zh: 反过来，人工智能帮助软件工程（SE）弥补了一个长期以来无法自行弥合的“知与行”之间的鸿沟：形式化需求、架构文档和系统性测试已被证明行之有效，却长期未被充分使用。 20世纪80年代和90年代的计算机辅助软件工程（CASE）工具曾试图弥合这一鸿沟，但却因其带来的额外负担而备受诟病。 人工智能改变了成本格局：实体化、验证和问责制（这些是软件工程领域几十年来逐步发展的概念）的应用成本随之降低。 规格说明曾经只有在关键领域才值得投入成本去创建和维护，如今则成为需求 elicitation 会议的副产品，并可以逐步形式化，从而重新与既有的软件工程实践接轨。 测试曾经是在代码编写完成后用于验证的代码，现在则变成了智能体生成内容时用以对照的参考依据。 Shaw 及其同事将这种结果称为“设计而非编码”（7）。 架构决策记录（Architecture Decision Records）曾经被视为文档债务，如今则成为智能体操作的基础载体。 那些原本局限于关键领域的实践，如今可以变得普遍适用，因为应用该方法所需的机械性成本已降至放弃使用的阈值以下。

paragraphs.en: The software engineer’s role now operates on three axes: methodological (providing the agent with sound SE structure); mediating (eliciting organization-specific domain knowledge and structuring it as verifiable artifacts); and custodial (owning the design and process choices that accumulate over the project’s lifetime). To govern an AI agent well, the engineer must know more SE, not less. The pattern is visible at organizational scale: the DORA 2025 State of AI report ( 8 ) , based on nearly five thousand professionals worldwide, finds that AI adoption amplifies practices already present. Teams with mature engineering foundations convert AI into delivery throughput; teams without them find AI accelerating instability rather than productivity.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程师的角色现在围绕三个维度展开：方法论（为智能体提供严谨的软件工程结构）；协调（提取组织特定的领域知识，并将其结构化为可验证的产物）；以及守护（负责项目生命周期中不断积累的设计与流程决策）。 要有效管理 AI 智能体，工程师必须掌握更多的软件工程知识，而非更少。 这一模式在组织层面清晰可见：DORA 2025《AI 现状》报告（8）基于全球近五千名专业人士的数据发现，AI 的采用放大了团队中已有的实践。 具备成熟工程基础的团队能将 AI 转化为交付吞吐量；而缺乏这些基础的团队则会发现，AI 加剧了不稳定性，而非提升了生产力。

sents.en: The software engineer’s role now operates on three axes: methodological (providing the agent with sound SE structure); mediating (eliciting organization-specific domain knowledge and structuring it as verifiable artifacts); and custodial (owning the design and process choices that accumulate over the project’s lifetime).
sents.zh: 软件工程师的角色现在围绕三个维度展开：方法论（为智能体提供严谨的软件工程结构）；协调（提取组织特定的领域知识，并将其结构化为可验证的产物）；以及守护（负责项目生命周期中不断积累的设计与流程决策）。

sents.en: To govern an AI agent well, the engineer must know more SE, not less.
sents.zh: 要有效管理 AI 智能体，工程师必须掌握更多的软件工程知识，而非更少。

sents.en: The pattern is visible at organizational scale: the DORA 2025 State of AI report ( 8 ) , based on nearly five thousand professionals worldwide, finds that AI adoption amplifies practices already present.

paragraphs.en: Sections 3 and 4 established that the four knowledge levers must be reified as artifacts, and that AI has made their reification sustainable beyond the critical domains that could once justify its cost. The artifacts named below are largely independent of the software lifecycle adopted; the list is not exhaustive.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节和第 4 节指出，必须将四个知识杠杆具体化为实体，而人工智能已使这种具体化能够超越以往可能证明其成本合理的临界领域而持续存在。 下文命名的这些实体在很大程度上独立于所采用的软件生命周期；该列表并不详尽。

sents.zh: 第 3 节和第 4 节指出，必须将四个知识杠杆具体化为实体，而人工智能已使这种具体化能够超越以往可能证明其成本合理的临界领域而持续存在。

sents.zh: 下文命名的这些实体在很大程度上独立于所采用的软件生命周期；该列表并不详尽。

paragraphs.en: Specifications (the primary operational artifact of spec-driven development ( 6 ) ) supply the model with the criterion of adequacy it cannot generate for itself. Architecture Decision Records encode the design choices that accumulate over the system’s life, along with the why and the intended trajectory that no session context preserves. Domain constraint records reify the organization-specific knowledge elicited from experts: the artifact form of what is otherwise permanently inconsistent and never articulated. Test frameworks structured for agent input externalize the reference of correctness the agent has no internal access to, becoming the agent’s proving ground and the engineer’s acceptance criterion. Process definitions instantiated per project make process choices executable rather than aspirational: the criteria for agent autonomy, the boundaries of automated action, the review structure. Design rationale records , finally, hold the custodial layer of coherence across accumulated decisions, distinguishing incidental patches from principled changes.
paragraphs.zh: 规范（规范驱动开发的主要运行产物 (6)）为模型提供了其自身无法生成的充分性标准。 架构决策记录编码了系统在生命周期中逐步积累的设计选择，以及这些选择的理由和预期方向——这些信息任何单次会话的上下文都无法保留。 领域约束记录将从专家处获取的组织特定知识实体化：它使那些原本永久不一致且从未明确表达的内容获得了具体的产物形式。 为智能体输入而构建的测试框架，将智能体无法内部访问的正确性参照外显化，从而成为智能体的验证场和工程师的验收标准。 按项目实例化的流程定义，使流程选择从理想状态变为可执行状态：它们构成了智能体自主性的标准、自动化行动的边界以及审查结构。 最后，设计理由记录则承载着贯穿所有累积决策的一致性维护层，从而区分出偶然性修补与基于原则的变更。

paragraphs.en: A natural question is whether AI changes development workflows. AI does not prescribe one. Any lifecycle a team adopts (waterfall, agile, spec-driven, or incremental refinement of existing practices) can be supported by an AI engine, provided the artifacts are present and continuously maintained. The “loop” now celebrated in agentic development revisits iterative, incremental development — long practiced in SE — now driven by an AI executor: AI empowering an established method. The ambition to drive the software process through such an engine is not new. Through the 1990s and 2000s, research on Process Modeling Languages and Process-centered Software Engineering Environments attempted to govern the software process through deterministic formal models. A 2014 retrospective concluded that formal process automation could succeed only in narrow technical phases such as code generation, testing, and deployment ( 9 ) . Deterministic execution cannot govern an activity whose normal state is inconsistency: it either blocks or forces premature resolution that erases information. AI resolves the problem differently: a probabilistic engine does not require constraint satisfaction, navigates incomplete specs, and surfaces inconsistencies as outputs for human judgment. The intent behind PSEE research is not abandoned. Where deterministic execution could not, probabilistic delivery opens a new direction.
paragraphs.zh: 一个自然的问题是，人工智能是否会改变开发工作流程。 人工智能并不会规定唯一一种流程。 团队所采用的任何生命周期（瀑布模型、敏捷方法、以规格驱动的方法，或对现有实践进行增量式改进）都可以由人工智能引擎支持，前提是相关工件存在且持续得到维护。 如今在智能体开发中备受推崇的“循环”，重新引入了迭代和增量式开发——这一软件工程领域早已实践的方法——但现在是由人工智能执行者来驱动的：人工智能为既定的方法注入力量。 通过这样的引擎来驱动软件流程的设想并非新鲜事。 在 20 世纪 90 年代和 21 世纪初，关于流程建模语言和以流程为中心的软件工程环境的研究，试图通过确定性的形式化模型来管理软件流程。 一项 2014 年的回顾性研究得出结论：形式化的流程自动化只能在代码生成、测试和部署等狭窄的技术阶段取得成功（9）。 确定性执行无法管理一种常态即为不一致的活动：它要么会阻塞流程，要么会强制过早解决，从而抹除信息。 人工智能以不同的方式解决了这个问题：概率性引擎不需要满足约束条件，能够处理不完整的规格说明，并将不一致之处作为输出呈现给人类判断。 PSEE 研究背后的初衷并未被放弃。 在确定性执行无法实现之处，概率性交付开辟了一个新的方向。

sents.zh: 一个自然的问题是，人工智能是否会改变开发工作流程。

sents.en: AI does not prescribe one.
sents.zh: 人工智能并不会规定唯一一种流程。

paragraphs.en: SE is not a discipline in decline. It is a discipline whose moment has arrived — the one that defines the structured space in which AI agents can be trusted. And the software engineer is not a professional in decline either — but the one who carries that knowledge into practice: who defines what the agent navigates by, who elicits the domain meaning that no corpus can supply, and who owns the trajectory of the system over time.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程并非一门正在衰落的学科。 它正是一个迎来其关键时刻的学科——正是这个学科界定了人工智能智能体可以被信赖的结构化空间。 而软件工程师也并非一个正在衰落的职业——相反，他们是将知识付诸实践的人：他们定义了智能体依据什么进行导航，他们提炼出任何语料库都无法提供的领域意义，并且掌控着系统随时间演变的轨迹。

sents.en: SE is not a discipline in decline.
sents.zh: 软件工程并非一门正在衰落的学科。

sents.en: It is a discipline whose moment has arrived — the one that defines the structured space in which AI agents can be trusted.
sents.zh: 它正是一个迎来其关键时刻的学科——正是这个学科界定了人工智能智能体可以被信赖的结构化空间。

sents.en: And the software engineer is not a professional in decline either — but the one who carries that knowledge into practice: who defines what the agent navigates by, who elicits the domain meaning that no corpus can supply, and who owns the trajectory of the system over time.

paragraphs.en: Reframe the question. The dominant debate asks whether AI will replace software engineers. The right question is different: what structured knowledge must govern AI agents to produce software that is correct, trustworthy, and built to last? Answering it requires SE and software engineers, not their abandonment.
paragraphs.zh: 重新表述这个问题。 主流争论聚焦于人工智能是否会取代软件工程师。 正确的问题却有所不同：需要哪些结构化知识来规范人工智能智能体，才能生成正确、可靠且经久耐用的软件？ 要回答这个问题，需要软件工程和软件工程师的参与，而非放弃他们。

sents.en: Reframe the question.
sents.zh: 重新表述这个问题。

sents.en: The dominant debate asks whether AI will replace software engineers.
sents.zh: 主流争论聚焦于人工智能是否会取代软件工程师。

sents.en: The right question is different: what structured knowledge must govern AI agents to produce software that is correct, trustworthy, and built to last?
sents.zh: 正确的问题却有所不同：需要哪些结构化知识来规范人工智能智能体，才能生成正确、可靠且经久耐用的软件？

sents.en: Answering it requires SE and software engineers, not their abandonment.
sents.zh: 要回答这个问题，需要软件工程和软件工程师的参与，而非放弃他们。

paragraphs.en: Redirect the investment. Specifications, domain elicitation, architectural governance, and process discipline are not overhead to minimize — they are the structured space within which AI agents can be trusted to operate with persistent and coherent memory. Organizations that treat them as optional will pay the cost in correctness, maintainability, and accountability.
paragraphs.zh: 重新引导投资方向。 规格定义、领域需求挖掘、架构治理和流程规范并非可以最小化的额外负担——它们构成了一个结构化空间，AI 智能体可以在其中被信任地运行，并具备持续且连贯的记忆能力。 那些将这些要素视为可选项的组织，将在正确性、可维护性和问责性方面付出代价。

sents.en: Redirect the investment.
sents.zh: 重新引导投资方向。

sents.en: Specifications, domain elicitation, architectural governance, and process discipline are not overhead to minimize — they are the structured space within which AI agents can be trusted to operate with persistent and coherent memory.
sents.zh: 规格定义、领域需求挖掘、架构治理和流程规范并非可以最小化的额外负担——它们构成了一个结构化空间，AI 智能体可以在其中被信任地运行，并具备持续且连贯的记忆能力。

sents.en: Organizations that treat them as optional will pay the cost in correctness, maintainability, and accountability.
sents.zh: 那些将这些要素视为可选项的组织，将在正确性、可维护性和问责性方面付出代价。

paragraphs.en: Revalue the discipline. SE education, research, and practice are not legacies to be displaced by AI fluency. They are prerequisites for AI exploitation and governance. A generation of developers trained only in prompting — without methodological knowledge, domain elicitation skill, or architectural judgment — will reproduce at scale the failure modes this paper describes.
paragraphs.zh: 重新评估这一学科的价值。 软件工程（SE）的教育、研究与实践并非因精通人工智能而可被取代的遗产。 它们是有效利用与治理人工智能的先决条件。 如果一代开发者仅接受提示工程训练，却缺乏方法论知识、领域需求挖掘能力或架构判断力，那么他们将在大规模应用中重演本文所描述的各种失败模式。

sents.zh: 重新评估这一学科的价值。

sents.en: They are prerequisites for AI exploitation and governance.
sents.zh: 它们是有效利用与治理人工智能的先决条件。

sents.en: A generation of developers trained only in prompting — without methodological knowledge, domain elicitation skill, or architectural judgment — will reproduce at scale the failure modes this paper describes.
